footerAccount: You get this email because it was requested from your account on {host}.

reset.subject: Choose a new password
reset.preheader: A link to set a new password for your orgtable account.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: Hi, {name}. Someone (probably you) asked to reset the password of your orgtable account. Use the button to choose a new one.
reset.notYou: Not you? Ignore this email: your password does not change unless someone uses the link.

invite.subject: {organization} created an orgtable account for you
invite.preheader: Choose your password to get into {organization}.
invite.title: {organization} created an account for you
invite.body: Hi, {name}. {inviter} added you to {organization} as {role}. There you organize work together on shared Kanban boards.
invite.ownership: The account is yours: you can change your password, download your data or delete it from the settings. {organization} can reset your password or remove you from the organization.
invite.footer: You get this email because {organization} created an account with this address.

changed.subject: Your orgtable password was changed
changed.preheader: If it was not you, reset it now.
changed.title: Your password was changed
changed.body: Hi, {name}. The password of your orgtable account was just changed with a reset link.
changed.button: It was not me: reset it
changed.notYou: If it was you, there is nothing else to do.
